lines.speaker: gravemaw
lines.text: Close enough. Draw, or say your piece.

lines.speaker: mc
lines.text: They're hunting both of us. I'd rather not do their work for them.

lines.speaker: gravemaw
lines.text: Three years I marched under that sigil. Then they burned a town for hiding one of us.

lines.speaker: gravemaw
lines.text: I took this sword off the bearer they hanged. It hasn't stopped talking since.

lines.speaker: gravemaw
lines.text: Then you know it never says anything kind. I'm {gravemaw_bearer}. Point me at them.

lines.speaker: blade
lines.text: Two of us, together again. That is how it begins.
